Bash(python3 -c "
dates = [
  \('Mar 3 \(before jingzhe\)', 343.0\),
  \('Mar 5 \(jingzhe starts\)', 345.0\),
  \('Mar 7 \(today\)',          347.0\),
  \('Mar 16 \(before chunfen\)', 356.0\),
  \('Mar 20 \(chunfen starts\)',   0.1\),
]
import math
print\(f'  Date                     lon     raw    old\(Int\)  new\(floor-0.5\)'\)
print\(f'  ----                     ---     ---    --------  --------------'\)
for label, lon in dates:
  result = \(lon + 7.5\) / 15
  old = int\(result\) % 24
  new = math.floor\(result - 0.5\)
  print\(f'  {label:<26} {lon:5.1f}°  {result:.3f}  {old:>2}        {new:>2}'\)
")
